description: Research Experience for Undergraduates (REU), NHERI 2025: Characterization of the Elastic–Plastic Behavior of a Superelastic Friction Damper is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Charles He, Case Western Reserve University (case.edu). This project develops a numerical model for the Superelastic Friction Damper to simulate its nonlinear response under cyclic loading. By combining a LuGre friction model with a superelastic SMA model, the approach captures both elastic and plastic behavior, including residual deformation. The model is calibrated using experimental data and particle swarm optimization. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 3 top-level files (PDF). Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-f86v-r092. Keywords: NSF NHERI Lehigh Real-Time Multi-Directional (RTMD) Experimental Facility, Structural damping, Seismic energy dissipation, Nonlinear modeling, Shape memory alloys, Earthquake engineering. Published 2025-08-14. Facility named: Real-Time Multi-Directional (RTMD) Experimental Facility with Large-Scale Hybrid Simulation Testing Capabilities - LeHigh University. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
